title: AARO under Kirkpatrick as a fly trap for UFO information

tellings.quote: And it is now kind of patently obvious that the first iteration of this under Sean Kirkpatre was literally a fly trap for you know UFO information probably had legacy ties.

plain: The Pentagon's UFO investigation office, in its first years under its director Sean Kirkpatrick around 2022 and 2023, was really a trap to catch UFO information as it came in, and probably had ties to older secret programmes. Michels says this himself as his own view, without naming a source, and if he is right it would mean the office was built to contain information rather than reveal it.
